# hermes-fleet

This fleet, as a UI. An open widget grid (drag / resize / swap / trash-to-delete, themed off --home-accent so it sits beside Home rather than fighting it) with a PUBLIC widget registry other plugins can register into — plus the package x profile matrix, live drift against this file, and per-profile context budget.

## Where it is installed

Profiles: `default`, `jason`, `tiferet`

| surface | where it lands | how |
|---|---|---|
| `agent-plugin` | `C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\plugins\hermes-fleet` (default) | link |
| `agent-plugin` | `C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\jason\plugins\hermes-fleet` (jason) | link |
| `agent-plugin` | `C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\tiferet\plugins\hermes-fleet` (tiferet) | link |

Surface kinds in play:

- **`agent-plugin`** — Agent plugin — loaded by the Hermes agent, per profile.

## Current state

In sync with `fleet.yaml`.

## Operating it

```bash
fleet status -v                 # includes this package
fleet sync -k hermes-fleet      # dry run, this package only
fleet sync -k hermes-fleet --apply
fleet enable hermes-fleet --apply   # add to plugins.enabled in each profile
fleet disable hermes-fleet --apply
hermes gateway restart          # required after an enable/disable
```

## Removing it

Take it out of `fleet.yaml`, then:

```bash
fleet disable hermes-fleet --apply
rm -rf 'C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\plugins\hermes-fleet'
rm -rf 'C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\jason\plugins\hermes-fleet'
rm -rf 'C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\tiferet\plugins\hermes-fleet'
```

> Those targets are links back into this checkout. Removing a link removes
> the link, never the source — but use `rm -rf` on the link itself, not on
> anything *inside* it, or you will delete the real files through it.

## Notes

A unified package: the agent half (plugin.yaml + plugin_api.py) installs into all three profiles, and the desktop app copies `desktop/plugin.js` out to ~/.hermes/desktop-plugins/hermes-fleet/ by itself. Built this way deliberately — one entry, both halves, and the desktop half stays global the way the loader wants.
